latest.title: Whitney extension theorem and intrinsic rectifiability of jump sets in Carnot-Carathéodory spaces
latest.abstract: We prove that the intrinsic jump set of every locally integrable function on an equiregular Carnot-Carathéodory space is intrinsically countably rectifiable. A key new ingredient is a local scalar Whitney extension theorem for intrinsic $C^1$ functions.
latest.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
latest.workSummary: 证明等正则 Carnot–Carathéodory 空间中局部可积函数的内蕴跳跃集可数内蕴可整流。
techniques: 内蕴 C¹ Whitney 延拓
latest.breakthrough: 构造局部标量延拓工具，推进非欧几何中的跳跃集结构理论。
latest.limitations: 等正则性关键，不能直接套到 Grushin 类秩变化空间。 已补读相关引言或主结果片段，尚未逐行验证完整证明。
latest.priorityReason: 次黎曼空间与整流性高度契合，延拓定理具有基础工具价值。
